pattern_text: Your account will be suspended unless you verify within 24 hours
note: Near-duplicate of an existing account_lock pattern — the reviewer should see that and reject.

pattern_text: Dear customer, complete your video KYC today to avoid service interruption
note: Video KYC is a newer vector not represented in the pattern set.

pattern_text: Your electricity connection will be disconnected tonight. Call the officer immediately.
note: Utility-disconnection scam; high volume in India, absent from the pattern set.

pattern_text: आपका खाता आज बंद हो जाएगा, तुरंत सत्यापित करें

آپ کا اکاؤنٹ بند کر دیا جائے گا، فوری تصدیق کریں
note: RTL case — the queue must not render this left-to-right.

pattern_text: Congratulations! You are selected for a government subsidy. Share your Aadhaar to claim.
